title: SeriesPoint
description: obs.series_point r1: one observation of a series as known from realtime_start.

observation_date.description: The date the observation refers to.

realtime_start.description: First date this value was the published one.

realtime_end.description: Last date this value was the published one.

value.description: The observation; null when the source has no value (nullable numeric).

status.description: Status of the observation, for example present or no_value.

currency.description: Currency code; not empty when unit is ccy_amount, empty otherwise.

published_at.description: Instant the source published the value.
